title: Jeans Jacket #AgisoftClothesChallenge
author: Sircher
acquisition: Reused the locally cached, downloadable Sketchfab-origin GLB after its author, model page, thumbnail and CC BY 4.0 license were verified.
textures: Original scan geometry and UVs retained. Runtime base-colour map removed for a uniform deep indigo fabric; the source normal map is retained.
runtimeModifications: All jacket meshes use #1A2A42, roughness 0.9, metalness 0, normal scale 1.5, and double-sided rendering; cast/receive shadows enabled.

carbonScenario.stageNote: 染色与纺织阶段占比极高
carbonScenario.source: Project owner's supplied estimate, not a verified product LCA or measurement of this model.
